title: A conservative functor to sets commuting with pushouts detects epimorphisms
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category which has pushouts (of pairs of morphisms with common source; [def-galois-finite-limits-colimits]), and let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathbf{Sets}$ be a functor which commutes with pushouts ([def-galois-exact-functor]) and reflects isomorphisms ([def-galois-reflects-isomorphisms]). Then a morphism $f:X\to Y$ of $\mathcal C$ is an epimorphism ([def-galois-epi-final]) if and only if the map $F(f):F(X)\to F(Y)$ is surjective.
